name: Dublin
industries: Technology European headquarters, financial services and pharmaceuticals make Dublin one of Europe's densest project markets.
intro:
Dublin's docklands host the European headquarters of the world's technology industry, and those employers hire delivery talent the way their US parents do — screened on credentials, funded by generous learning budgets. Beyond tech, post-Brexit financial relocations keep adding programme roles, and the pharma corridor within commuting distance runs validation-heavy projects where formal method is mandatory. Irish salaries for certified professionals track among Europe's best. Batches are scheduled live online across the whole year at hours built for Dublin: a weekend Sat–Sun cohort and a weekday Wed–Thu cohort each week, all landing in comfortable local daytime; every upcoming date and its exact Dublin timing is listed in the schedule below. You train with an international cohort that looks like a Dublin office. Afterwards you get exam application guidance, full-length mock exams, and open trainer access for doubts until you certify.

Dublin hosts the EMEA operations of a striking share of global tech and pharma, and those organizations import their certification culture wholesale: project and program roles in multinationals here list credentials as standard, and the local consultancies staffing them follow suit. The result is one of Europe's most credential-dense job markets relative to size. The course runs live online across two consecutive days in Irish hours — no M50 crawl to a venue. Dublin salaries for certified project professionals reflect multinational pay scales; verify against the sourced entries below, which name their sources and dates. The employer list shows the tech-pharma-finance triangle that hires here, and multinationals certifying delivery teams across EMEA can anchor private cohorts from Dublin.

faq.q: What are the class timings in Dublin?
faq.a: Live classes run 09:00 AM – 06:00 PM UK, which is 09:00 AM – 06:00 PM GMT+1 in Dublin. You can pick a weekend (Sat–Sun) or a weekday (Wed–Thu) cohort; each completes the course over two consecutive days.

faq.q: Is the training online or at a venue in Dublin?
faq.a: All batches are 100% live online, taught by an instructor over video with interactive exercises — there is no venue to travel to in Dublin. You need a laptop, a stable connection and a free weekend.

faq.q: Is the certificate different if I attend from Ireland?
faq.a: No. The certification is issued by the same global body regardless of where you attend from, and holds identical recognition with employers in Ireland and internationally.

faq.q: Can my employer in Dublin sponsor the course?
faq.a: Yes. We issue invoices suitable for corporate sponsorship and reimbursement, and most employers in Ireland accept them under learning and development budgets. Group pricing is available for teams.

faq.q: Should I pick the weekday or weekend {course} batch in Dublin?
faq.a: Identical {course} syllabus either way — choose whichever pair of days your Dublin schedule can spare. The batch table above shows every session converted to Dublin local time.

faq.a: Yes — the {course} exam can be taken online from Dublin; you do not need to travel. The exam and certification guide further up this page explains the exact format, attempts and booking process.

faq.a: Yes. The {course} credential is issued by its global certifying body and is the one most commonly named in relevant Dublin job descriptions. The employer list on this page shows where certified professionals in Dublin work.

faq.a: See the salary table on this page — every Dublin figure carries a named source and an as-of date, so you can verify it rather than trust a marketing average. Certified professionals typically use these sourced numbers in appraisal and offer negotiations.

faq.a: The batch table above lists the next start dates for Dublin — two cohorts run every week (weekday and weekend), so you are never more than a few days from a {course} start.

faq.a: Yes. Teams in Dublin can enroll together under group pricing, and larger groups can run a private {course} cohort scheduled to their own calendar — use the enquiry option on this page with your team size.

faq.q: What language is the {course} training in Dublin delivered in?
